title: Website Opportunities after #1427: the QA reader follows nav links written to the published hostname (WordPress), a later research swaps stored feed-size Facebook photos for their originals, and the hand-off door queues its prompt into the site's chat itself
steps: S1: export TEST_DATABASE_URL to a reachable Postgres (the web suites make and drop a throwaway database).
S2: From the TCH checkout run the four node --test files named in `run.cmd` (host demo-qa, web doors, web executor, plugin handoff-entry).
S3: Read the tap lines of the tests named in `run.tests` and the exit code.
expect: navPathsOf keeps '/menu', '/about/', '/gallery?x=1' from a page on 127.0.0.1:5000 when the published host is wp-marigold1.wo.tracy.test (absolute menu links, case-insensitive host), and drops home, index.php, a .pdf, evil.test and facebook.com; without the published host only the page's own origin counts.

Executor: research 1 stores the Facebook feed copy (width 60) when its photo page is down; research 2 (source already complete, nothing collected) stores the original (width 1280, source_url the ctp=s1280x720 address) and marks the feed row status 'reference', reason 'superseded'; progress.media.upgraded = 1; coverage.photoPages = {tried: 2, upgraded: 1}; collected.media[0].url is the original and fallbackUrl the feed copy; research 3 reads no photo page and changes nothing.

Doors: the first hand-off press with no site row queues no prompt and answers no promptSent; the press after the site row exists queues exactly one prompt into the held chat 'wo-demo-<buildId>' with requestId 'wo-handoff:<buildId>:wo-demo-<buildId>' and the handoff's own prompt text, answers next '/<site>/s/wo-demo-<buildId>' and handoff.promptSent {at, sessionId: 'wo-demo-<buildId>'}; a third press makes no new chat, queues nothing more and keeps promptSent; GET …/handoff returns promptSent.
Doors: a chat that refuses the prompt fails closed: 503 HANDOFF_PROMPT_FAILED, nothing left for the page to send; the next press queues it again and promptSent names the session it went to.

Client handoff-entry: the page never sends a prompt. An old wo-handoff address only reads the server receipt and loses the parameter: with promptSent it reports nothing, without it HANDOFF_NOT_READY; neither drafts nor submits.
Every test named in run.tests reports ok and the command exits 0.

selectors.host: apps/tracy-host/src/demo-qa.js navPathsOf(hrefs, pageUrl, siteHosts); runDemoQa passes siteHosts = [asked.host]
selectors.web: packages/wo/website-opportunities/src/executor.js media stage upgradeFacebookStored → store.supersedeMedia; route.js POST /api/website-opportunities/builds/:id/handoff → deps.prompt, handoff.promptSent
selectors.client: packages/site/tracy-website-opportunities/src/client/handoff-entry.ts only reads the server receipt and removes wo-handoff; it has no composer to send through

evidence: Stand wo, 18–19/10/2026: wp-marigold1 qa.pages = ["/"] with discover on (menu links are absolute to wp-marigold1.wo.tracy.test:46080, the reader opened a loopback address); Fern Station re-research kept 103 stored Facebook photos at ≤ 1419 px because the source was complete; qa-marigold3's prompt waited 40 min for a page that never settled (tasks/plan-website-opportunities-pictures.md §11–12).
fence: Pure judge and the executor against a Postgres with the connectors stubbed; the browser half (readInPage handing back navHrefs) and a real WordPress demo on a stand are measured in tasks/evidence-wo-qa-pages.md, not here.

tests: navPathsOf keeps links on the page origin or the published host
a later research swaps a stored feed-size Facebook photo for its original
handoff: the stored pictures go onto the ready site one by one, once, and the prompt names their paths
handoff: a refused prompt fails closed; the next press uses the same session and request id
historical URLs remove their parameter and only read server receipts; an unaccepted prompt cannot be sent by the page

history: 24/10/2026: 1a7870661f (19/10/2026, durable demo builds) made the server the only sender of the hand-off prompt: a refused prompt now fails closed (503 HANDOFF_PROMPT_FAILED) instead of leaving it to the page, and handoff-entry only reads receipts. It replaced 'handoff: a chat that refuses the prompt leaves it to the page; the next press tries again' and 'a handoff the server already queued into the chat sends nothing and says nothing'.
24/10/2026: e3dcc4dd33 (20/10/2026) holds one chat per build, 'wo-demo-<buildId>', instead of 'session-made-1'; the doors line follows it.
